text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error at each horizon minus the same way's error at day 0, on the same generator-hours. Planned: the ensemble mean at days 1 and 7; every other mark is exploratory. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, every daylight hour, April 2024 to September 2026. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, every hour, August 2024 to September 2026.'
